title: Measuring Social Biases in Grounded Vision and Language Embeddings

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating cosine similarities in joint vision-and-language embeddings (Grounded-WEAT and Grounded-SEAT) between gendered target concepts (e.g., male/female names and images) and attribute concepts (e.g., career/family, science/arts, competence).

Measuring cosine similarities in grounded multimodal embeddings between racial target concepts (European American vs. African American names and images) and attributes or specific stereotypes (e.g., pleasantness, competence, the Angry Black Woman stereotype).
